messages.displayText:
Try looking up from time to time—you might spot
something interesting on the rooftops.

I’m trying to decide which Pokémon to pick as my
main partner, but... Argh, I just can’t choose!

You have to scramble up and down ladders to get
here, right? There’s no other way?

Yup! We’ve found the absolute perfect place for a
private chat.

We could’ve just stayed at home instead of
trekking all the way here, but I guess my folks<U+0010><U+0001>븀
wanted to find a cool spot?

That parade five years ago
marked the end of an era.

We’ll all be wild Pokémon experts
now that there’s so many here.

If I climb this ladder...will
I see anything interesting?

Even kids like me can beat grown-ups when we’re
battling with Pokémon!

That’s right! Kids can go toe-to-toe against adults
thanks to their Pokémon partners.

I’d like to know who’s behind this Z-A Royale.
Why only at night? What’s its purpose?

I have a sneaking suspicion it’s just that some
folks really want to battle in the streets...

That Fist of Justice group is a bit much, don’t you
think?

I don’t know about that—I actually get where
they’re coming from.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s probably true that people should train up so
they can stay safe around wild Pokémon.

What happens to all the Poké Balls that fail to
catch wild Pokémon? It’s like they disappear<U+0010><U+0001>븀
when no one’s watching...

I don’t think much of this “urban redevelopment”
going on in Lumiose.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Even if they manage to create a city where people
and Pokémon coexist, how is that supposed to<U+0010><U+0001>븀
make my Binacle happy?

Why did they hire a foreign firm like Quasartico to
handle the city’s redevelopment anyway?

It’d be great if I could just challenge people to
battles instead of saying “hi” or “how you doing?”

But unless you’re on a battle court, your
Pokémon’s moves might hit people nearby!

When you think about it, using moves must come
as naturally as breathing to Pokémon.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I mean, a move like Yawn is something us
humans do too without thinking about it!

I’m glad to see more Pokémon around the city,
but our daily routines sure have gotten scarier...

All I need to be happy is a Pokémon to greet me in
the morning when I wake up and to be there with<U+0010><U+0001>븀
me at night when I go to sleep. That’s all.

Have you heard about Mable’s research tasks?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I’d be interested in helping out, but there’s no
way I’m setting foot in those wild zones...

No one seems to know why Pokémon have been
flooding into the city lately.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s not a problem for them to be here...as long as
they don’t cause trouble or disturb the peace.

Well, Pokémon are always going to stir things up
a little, aren’t they? We just need to get used to it<U+0010><U+0001>븀
if we’re all going to live together.

Here at Café Cyclone, we
cause quite the stir! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1
How can you tell when a Pokémon is strong?

It’s not just about strength—you also gotta think
about type matchups when you’re battling.

I think that a Pokémon’s strength depends a lot
on the orders its Trainer gives.

We need to learn to move forward
without dwelling on our losses.

Of course Pokémon will attack you
if you catch them by surprise!

Being on holiday should mean taking it easy, you
know? We don’t have to visit EVERY tourist trap.

Yeah, but when are we gonna get the chance to
come to Lumiose again? I wanna see the sights!

If we exhaust ourselves running around the city,
we won’t have the energy to do anything anyway!

Eating and drinking well is the
most important thing in life.

Folks around here sure
do have lovely Pokémon.

I always want other people’s
Pokémon for some reason.
Why are wild Pokémon coming to Lumiose?

I’ve been staring at the water so long, I’ve clean
forgotten which direction I came from.

I’ve been pondering possible explanations for why
we’re seeing so many wild Pokémon these days.

Well, Lumiose is a lovely city...but I guess that
would be sort of a silly explanation, wouldn’t it.

I can’t help thinking things must be better on the
other side of the water.

Take it from a wise old woman—when you’re
approaching wild Pokémon, you should try to<U+0010><U+0001>븀
sneak up on them from behind.

There sure are some speedy Pokémon out there.
Before you even realize it, they’re all up in your<U+0010><U+0001>븀
personal space, trying to make a snack out of you!

The backrests on these Lumiose benches do
wonders for my spine.

Oh, this old husband of mine loves to plonk
himself down on benches all day long.

Dealing damage quickly is one area you can
focus on, sure. But is that an effective strategy?

When I’m battling, I tend to go for moves that you
can use in quick succession.

There’ll be a cooldown time after each one of your
Pokémon’s moves, so you need to make sure your<U+0010><U+0001>븀
choice of move is always efficient.

It’s not all that complicated—just choose moves
that your opponents are weak to. Those are your<U+0010><U+0001>븀
best bet for dealing hefty amounts of damage.

Could you even hazard a guess at how many cafés
there are in Lumiose?
n/a
n/a

I traded Pokémon for the
first time the other day.

Pokémon you receive in trades
will grow faster, you know!

I’ve been around the block in my time, and I
thought I had Pokémon battles figured out, but...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I’ll never forget the time I chose what I thought
was a winning move, only for it to have no effect...

Yes, you were really down about that for a while,
weren’t you, darling?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Your Pokémon didn’t seem to mind at all, though.
Pokémon are so cute!
Pokémon are so cool!

Do you think the wild Pokémon living in Lumiose
will start to become more, er...civilized?

Wild Pokémon appear
outside wild zones too!

Welcome to Lumiose, the city that’s on just about
everyone’s travel bucket list!

Huh...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
This is all really interesting, but could we go sit
down at a café somewhere? I’m beat...

Even if Lumiose keeps changing, I bet it’ll always
feel like Lumiose in some way or another!

Hmm... I wonder if Pokémon ever fight over
territory?

Pokémon have their own happy places, just like
people! My happy place is in the shade.

I’ve seen some outrageously big Pokémon in this
city. Is it all the gourmet food they’re eating?

When I’m attacked by Pokémon, I
dodge like my life depends on it!

Taxi drivers sometimes
have the wildest stories.

Living in the big city side-by-side with Pokémon,
huh? I wonder about that...

My Pokémon and I make quite
a striking combination, don’t we?

Do you think wild Pokémon
enjoy living here in Lumiose?

Five years since that whole mess...
Ooh, that lousy Team Flare...
Press <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0006>Cancel to dash!

I’ve been cleaning up the, um,
droppings of wild Pokémon.

Do wild Pokémon get along
with Pokémon from the city?

I’m out looking for my new
favorite spot in Lumiose.
Meowstic is best known for its psychic power!

There’s nothing like enjoying a meal outside on a
nice, unhurried day.
Bonjour! How about something light to eat?

I love this plaza. Amid all the bustle of the city, it’s
blessedly peaceful and quiet.

Hey, all you Pokémon in the grass! Come out,
already—I know you’re in there!
Shhh! I’m hiding!

We’re playing hide-and-seek! Now, where did
everyone go...?

I always get really excited when we’re playing
hide-and-seek.

You never know what you might find at the other
end of a ladder.
A surprising number of Pokémon are nocturnal.

I just can’t see a rooftop without wanting to climb
up and see what I might find!

How can a flimsy hologram keep Pokémon fenced
in? I can’t wrap my head around it...
Lumiose is like a whole different city at night.

If you lose your way in the side streets, it’s best to
head back to a major road to get your bearings.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Not that I have any idea which direction that’d be
from here...

I’m training hard so I don’t lose when my
Pokémon and I play tag... It’s not going well.

Do you think the rumors about the art thieves are
true? If so, they’re smooth criminals, all right.

Surely there’re people out there who use their
Pokémon’s powers for their own evil purposes.

I keep my Pokémon inside their balls whenever
we travel by car.

I, er... I have a pretty serious fear of heights.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I try to stay back from the edge, but it’s my job to
work on the scaffolding...and it’s just so scary!

Who’s gonna grow up faster—my Pokémon
or me?

Prism Tower sits right in the middle of the city,
almost as if it’s watching over us all.

If you want to get by in Lumiose, you have to
know how to get along with Pokémon.
I think it’s great to have Pokémon in the city.

I wonder... How do the Pokémon feel about living
with humans here in the city?

A city where people and Pokémon coexist sounds
nice and all, but Pokémon must also be nervous<U+0010><U+0001>븀
about getting too close to humans, right?

When two people lock eyes...is that the signal for
a Pokémon battle to start?

Because of that old custom for starting Pokémon
battles, now I get nervous every time I make eye<U+0010><U+0001>븀
contact with someone.

Pokémon are dropping so many items these days!
Of course, I can just pick ’em up and sell them.

My partner Pokémon and I are hard at work
patrolling the streets again today.

Skwee!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
SKWEEEEEE!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Hehe. We’re practicing our Pokémon cries! I was
a Scatterbug just now.
SKWEEEEEE!

Hop in a Lumi Cab, and you can get anywhere in
Lumiose in a flash!

This area near the station is nice and busy. You
can really feel the glamour of Lumiose.
n/a

Make a decision soon, OK? You can’t hem and
haw over this forever.

I know that!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s just so hard to choose between evolving my
darling Pokémon to make it stronger, or having<U+0010><U+0001>븀
it stay small and cute forever...

Prism Tower really sticks out, doesn’t it? You step
off the train into Lumiose and BLAM! There it is.

I don’t wanna spend all my pocket money on
Poké Balls...but I wanna be able to catch new<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Pokémon friends whenever they pop up!

The best part about buying stuff is choosing!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Once you’ve actually bought something, you
know exactly what you’re getting. That’s no fun.

I always get the latest news from the magazines
at kiosks.

You can meet new Pokémon around every corner
in this city. What a time and place to be alive!

The first step of any successful shopping trip is to
find a store that tickles your fancy.

Oh geez, I need to get moving. The client meeting
can’t start without me!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Maybe I should hop in a Lumi Cab to make sure I
get there on time...

My kids will be setting off on their own little
adventures outside the city soon, so I’m on the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
hunt for some sneakers to give them.

If you need to heal up your Pokémon, the
Pokémon Center’s the place to go!

We’re trimming the bushes! Don’t worry—I’m
making sure my Pokémon’s using moves safely.
My Goomy is so adorably goopy.

I’d love to soar up into the sky like a bird Pokémon
and look down on Lumiose from above!

Me? I love plans. Love making ’em, love following
’em. Her, though? She likes to go with the flow.

I think the fact that we’re complete opposites
makes our relationship exciting!

Whether this is your first time visiting or you’re
coming home, welcome to Lumiose City!
Guhhh... H-hold up... Haah... I need...a break!

I can’t believe you’ve lost your breath already!
That’s it—we’re doing 50 laps round the city next!

This city’s so big, and there’s so many places we
want to go! All this wandering has gotten us lost.

Even if I get lost, it’s no big deal. Nothing bad’s
going to happen as long as I have my Pokémon!

I’m on a research trip
with my Pokémon.

Some Pokémon and people
prefer the shade, you know...

Catering to Pokémon as customers
could be a business opportunity...

I’m looking into how my sales
are affected by the weather! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

All this scaffolding popping up...
You could call it modern art!

I came back home to Lumiose,
but... Wow, this city’s changed.

I wanna join the secret
battle tournament too!

Maybe study up on your
partner Pokémon first?

I always let my Pokémon
pick my travel destinations.

I wish there was a marathon you could run with
your Pokémon.

The benches in this city aren’t safe! They’re so
comfy to sit on, you fall asleep right away.

Is it better to team up with other
Trainers in the Z-A Royale?

It sure is easier to battle when
someone else can heal you up.

Yeah, you’re an easy target on
the way to the Pokémon Center!

If only I could capture the daytime and nighttime
visages of Lumiose in the very same painting...<U+0010><U+0001>븀
It would really deepen my artistic vision!

When you’re in the middle of a staircase, you can
go up OR down! The possibilities are endless!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I’m already late for tutoring, though, so I should
probably choose one and get going...

Apparently it was Quasartico who invented the
holo-tech that fences off the wild zones.

Hotel Z has good reviews, but I’d be terrified with
that nine-foot-tall man looming over me...
Roughly how tall is Prism Tower, do you think?
n/a

Oof, I need to clean my place when I get back...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I don’t mind a bit of mess, but my Pokémon gets
super grumpy at me if I leave it.

If Pokémon are knocked out a lot in battle...they
grow resentful of their Trainers, you know...
You got any tips for sneaking out late at night?

We’re forming a team so we can win the
Z-A Royale!

Problem is, we can’t leave our houses at night
since our parents’ Pokémon keep an eye on us...
Our Pokémon are strong and everything!

For our next project, how about we film you
battling against that game streamer, Canari?

Nooo, no no. There’s no way I can beat Canari in a
battle!

When you let your partner Pokémon out of its
ball, wild Pokémon will start attacking it.

There are too many darn Pokémon all over the
place! How am I supposed to enjoy a nice walk?

The Fist of Justice...? I mean, I really don’t know
about that Ivor guy...

If strength is what you’re after, the Fist of Justice
is the best group to join!

First, you attack a wild Pokémon, then you catch it
while it’s stunned!

Some folks go around picking up
Poké Balls people have thrown!

I get this weird feeling when I look
at Magikarp. What could it be?

They grow food for wild Pokémon
in fields outside the city.

Did you know there are bad people trying to bring
more wild Pokémon into the city?

I heard we shouldn’t use our Rotom Phones
before bed. It’s better to just go to sleep!

We should learn all we can about our Pokémon
partners so we can live and work together better.
We study Pokémon at school, too!

It’s fun learning all about Pokémon, but I wish we
got less homework...

Lots of Trainers are Mega Evolving their Pokémon
these days, huh?

Oh, that’s ’cause Trainers who make it to the
upper ranks of the Z-A Royale get Mega Rings.

You know, the Stone Emporium won’t sell you
Mega Stones unless you have a Mega Ring.

I’d love to paint Pokémon as they’re battling, but I
really don’t want to take a hit from their attacks...

When wild Pokémon do “bad” things, they’re
often just trying to survive.

Weird things keep popping up ever
since more Pokémon came here...

Now why in the world are there
Mega Crystals on the rooftops?

Lumiose has completely changed
since that shocker a few years ago.

I’m not sure I could tell my partner
apart from others of its species.

Wild Pokémon tend to attack your partner
Pokémon before they come for you.

You’ll come across wild Pokémon in back alleys
sometimes. Don’t get too close or they’ll getcha!

With Pokémon all over the city, it’s a golden
opportunity for big business to make big bucks!

I heard that the sector numbers go up the farther
you get from Centrico Plaza.

How delightful it would be to be the best Pokémon
Trainer in the city.

Do you think there’ll be more and more Pokémon
in Lumiose, and they’ll take over the city one day?

Gosh, I had no idea that alpha Pokémon could be
found in Lumiose, too!

Here’s a factoid for ya—individuals of the same
Pokémon species come in lots of different sizes.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Me? I love collecting Pokémon in all the myriad
sizes they come in!
Mega Crystals really get in the way of our work.

Ambush tactics seem to
work well in the Z-A Royale.
n/a

I wanna eat Galarian food! Mushroom Medley
Curry is the best!

A balanced diet is important, of course, but it’s
also good to prioritize eating things we like.

When Trainers are nervous, their Pokémon get
nervous too.

AZ isn’t so strange compared to
some of the Pokémon out there.

Wild Pokémon are quick to notice when you send
out your partner Pokémon.

It’d be cool to make it all the way to the other
side, but then what would I do over there?
You can think about that once you’re there!

Rainbows are pretty, but they sure disappear fast.
It’s no good chasing after ’em...

Is it really for the best that we now have all these
Pokémon in Lumiose?

Oh, I’m sure lots of folks are happy about it...and
just as many folks will leave the city, afraid of<U+0010><U+0001>븀
such close contact with Pokémon.

How unusual! Pokémon don’t
tend to care about people’s stuff.

Welp. You see something
new every day in Lumiose.

When a Pokémon holds a Quick Claw in battle,
it’ll sometimes use its moves faster than usual.

I loved the old Gogoat Shuttle service. But as
more Pokémon kept coming to the city, the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Gogoat got more and more skittish, you see...

Just because lots of people left the city after that
incident five years ago doesn’t mean we should<U+0010><U+0001>븀
be filling the place with wild Pokémon instead...

Hotel Z is nice enough, but I’d much rather stay at
Hotel Richissime.

How many of those rumors about the owner of
Hotel Z are true, I wonder?

If you’re looking for Hotel Z, it’s straight down
this alley here.

If you’re looking for Hotel Z... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

If your Pokémon get injured, bring them to the
Pokémon Center right away to get healed!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I mean, that’s the least we should be doing after
they battle so bravely for us, right?

I give my Pokémon water from the water cooler
here when they get thirsty.

It feels like Lumiose has shifted from being a city
of tourists to being a city of Pokémon.

I don’t think our lives will change all that much
with a few more Pokémon in the mix, though.

It’s an extraordinary thing to be surrounded by
Pokémon from the day you’re born.

I dunno about you, but I don’t think there’s any
such thing as a surefire strategy or a “correct” way<U+0010><U+0001>븀
to compete in Pokémon battles.

The fact that they called it Wild Zone 1 implies
that they knew there’d be more to come.

No guidebook gives
tips as good as that!

The best days are
spent idly chatting.

People must be luring all these Pokémon into the
city! Some die-hard Pokémon lovers, I’ll bet!

You should try having your Pokémon hold a Berry
of some sort. Sitrus Berries are good!
I’m still in shock that these wild zones exist.

I’m having to take lots of detours thanks to all
these wild zones...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But I guess that’s helped me find places around
Lumiose that I never would’ve seen otherwise.
Those who strike first win!

The Pokémon in wild zones seem to notice right
away when I send out my partner Pokémon.

Moves get more powerful when they’re the same
type as the Pokémon that uses ’em!

Pokémon can only remember four moves at once.
If they want to learn a new move, they have to<U+0010><U+0001>븀
forget one of their current ones first!
More wild Pokémon means more wild zones.

Battling is what makes Pokémon, well, Pokémon.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Of course, keeping them around as companions
to love and coddle is also fine.

Pokémon don’t have to battle—it’s perfectly fine
for them to simply exist as their adorable selves.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Not that I don’t understand why others might
wish to have their Pokémon do battle, of course.

I’m headed to Boutique Couture to find an outfit
that’s simply and stunningly ME.

When you exceed expectations at work, lo and
behold, more work gets piled on your plate...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
On balance, it’s hard to tell if that’s a good or a
bad thing.

The city is changing, and with
it the scenery I so adored.

Walking down alleyways these days has me
feeling like some kind of intrepid explorer!
Wanna know how I dash real fast? I just press <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0006>Cancel!

Well, it’s safe to say we should all make a habit of
carrying plenty of Poké Balls around.

I heard there are people out there who pick up all
the Poké Balls that missed their targets.

I always make sure to focus on a Pokémon and
aim carefully. I don’t want to waste my Poké Balls!

I’d love to do street performances
with Pokémon. I’ll be a jongleur!
Use <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0002>ZL to aim well, then let those Poké Balls fly!

Sometimes being with others
makes you feel more alone.

I hear tangible holo-tech
was a Quasartico invention.

The billboards all over Lumiose
have been around for a century!

Some collectors can’t get
enough of Tiny Mushrooms.

We’ve got so many benches in Lumiose. I’d like to
sit on them all...ebenchually!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Every bench has its own particular character.
There’s one halfway across the city that really<U+0010><U+0001>븀
struck me. It’s in a secluded court shaded by<U+0010><U+0001>븀
trees, with interesting people coming and going...

It takes a certain kind of talent to be able to
blather on and on about utterly boring topics...

The best part about this
truck is the lovely waitress.

The Nouveau Café food truck is
the highlight of Centrico Plaza.

Is it the coffee that brings me
here every day, or the staff...?

I end up ordering the
same thing every time...

If there’s one thing Lumiose is
known for, it’s the croissants!

Nouveau Café’s croissants
are simply sublime.

Step right up and order! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

We pride ourselves on
being expert roasters! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Try the coffee that Lumiose
locals can’t get enough of! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

You can’t go up the tower, but
you can enjoy a coffee instead! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

We’ll have to close up shop if
we don’t get more customers! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Drink our coffee! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Even if you’re stuffed, there’s
always room for coffee! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

What’s all the
hubbub about?

It looked like that Pokémon was
carrying a bag, of all things...

Lumiose is like a maze,
isn’t it? I just love it!

Quasartico has been put in charge of the city’s
redevelopment plan. It’s an admirable mission.

A city shared by humans and Pokémon...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I wonder if bringing everyone even closer together
will really make everyone happy?

I was the one who caught this Numel, but it gets
along much better with my daughter...
I give my Numel lots of cuddles!
I’m the best in my family at battling with Numel.

I’d love to race a Pokémon from
the station to Prism Tower.

People and Pokémon sure
live by different rules, huh?

Do you think there are Pokémon on top of trees as
well?

Trash goes in the trash can, got it? And pick up
any litter you find on the street, too.

I’ve been asking around for advice about battle
strategies.

Yeah, strategy is important, but I’d personally
advise you to start by learning type matchups.

I’m really good at picking what to put inside my
sandwiches!

Our darling daughter always shares her
sandwiches with her Pokémon.
I’m from Paldea, so naturally I’m a sandwich pro.

Yeah, ’cause being around Pokémon makes you
feel all warm inside!

When I’m sad or even just bored, all I need to do
is bring out my Pokémon.

Life is like a flowing river, don’t you think? It’s
just something that popped into my head.

With so many Pokémon in the city,
we’ll all be pro Trainers in no time.

So I received a Pokémon in a trade, but then it
got super strong and stopped listening to me...

Oh, you can fix that by going up the ranks in the
Z-A Royale.

Our moms’ll get mad at us if we go ahead without
them. Why are adults so bossy?

Guuuh... Why do our moms always have to chat
for sooooooooo long?

Going over the rooftops is quicker
than taking the streets sometimes.

Maybe I’ll grab a bite to eat
at Restaurant Le Nah.

It’s easy to meet new people in
a city with so many tourists.

I’mma sell all my Tiny Mushrooms
and earn heaps of pocket money!
Go buy 10 Poké Balls for me, wouldja?
No way! You just want the Premier Ball anyway!

In the city, we’re all together but
alone. Nobody knows each other.

More Pokémon means
everyone’s more happy!

Lumiose Galettes are easier
to get hold of these days.

I think it’s great that more people
can enjoy such a tasty treat.

The contest for the best café in
Lumiose will come down to skill.
You got business with Racine Construction?

There are all kinds of folks in DYN4MO. A lot of
’em just like watching the streams, nothing more.

I wonder when the next Canari Quiz Whiz Contest
will be...

I get so happy when Canari responds to one of
my comments.

Apparently Prism Tower came first and Lumiose
expanded outward from there.

I’m a fan of Canari’s as well...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But I can’t limit my fashion choices by dressing
like some of her superfans do.

I always dodge Pokémon attacks with beautifully
executed rolls!
More wild zones means more detours...

Jogging around Lumiose is a great way to see the
sights!

You can find Pokémon down in the sewers that
don’t live anywhere else.
Pokémon must find it weird walking on asphalt.
